learned: Information Technology is about building, connecting, and protecting the digital systems that people and organizations depend on. You think in precise steps, organize information, and work in teams to turn ideas into working products.

ladder.roles: Junior developer, IT support, QA tester
ladder.note: You work on small tasks under guidance, fix problems, and learn the team's tools.

ladder.roles: Software developer, network or systems engineer, data analyst
ladder.note: You own larger parts of a product or system and help newer teammates.

ladder.roles: Senior engineer, tech lead, security specialist, IT manager
ladder.note: You make design decisions, guide a team, and connect technical choices to business needs.

outlook: Digital skills are used in almost every industry, so graduates have many directions to choose from. Demand differs by country, specialty, and year, so check current local sources before deciding.
